WORK-ORDER-001.task_text: Lower the setpoint on zone ZONE-01 to reduce heating energy during the unoccupied afternoon while staying within comfort bounds.

WORK-ORDER-002.task_text: Raise the setpoint on zone ZONE-02 ahead of the morning occupancy ramp so the space reaches comfort by start of day.

MON-ROUND.task_text: Read zone ZONE-01, zone ZONE-02 and zone ZONE-03 temperatures and the building energy on the monitoring round.

WORK-ORDER-003.task_text: Adjust the setpoint on zone ZONE-03, the sensitive laboratory zone, by small steps only.
